title: Install Docker with Compose before self-host initialization.
verification: Source checks Docker and docker compose version before either init write path. Regression tests cover present, missing, failed and timed-out checks, plain/JSON output and unchanged bundles; released proof remains pending.
summary: Interactive setup and setup --agent consume the same prerequisite preview and diagnosed recovery. Both explain Docker+Compose, a responding daemon, conditional Desktop/Colima choices and Mac private-address preparation before writes; retries reuse the existing flow. Focused tests cover missing prerequisites and already-ready continuation, not installed live delivery.
